comment: Source-of-truth manifest for official vendor icon collections. scripts/importers/official-icons.py reads this; add or change a vendor here, not in code. 'format' selects the pack-layout parser; 'root' is relative to scripts/cloud-diagram-sources/.

azure.terms: Microsoft permits use in architecture diagrams, training materials, and documentation; do not alter the artwork.

aws.terms: AWS permits these assets for architecture diagrams and related materials; AWS asset terms remain.

gcp.terms: Google product-icon and trademark terms remain; do not alter the artwork.
